reason: Replaces per-packet global Mutex<HashMap> with sharded DashMap on the UDP forwarding hot path (crates/node/src/forwarder/udp.rs).
Converts O(n) allocating case-insensitive lookups into O(1) zero-allocation map lookups in src/validation.
Shares one resty.Client across requests to cut GC churn, CPU and TLS handshakes in the Go server.
Title says it avoids a LoadLocation syscall on every TibiaDataDatetime call in server code.
Removes per-badge findOne N+1 query and parallelizes notification list queries in backend services/controllers.
Adds missing MongoDB indexes to model schemas to speed high-traffic queries (database load).
Batches GitOps compose-path lookups and memoizes compose resolution once per project list request.
Filters unhealthy containers at the Docker daemon in the auto-heal background job instead of listing all.
Consolidates per-client environment stream polling into one shared producer in backend handler.
Parallelizes data loading in frontend/src/routes/+layout.ts, which is browser code.
Replaces per-image Docker inspects and DB queries with batched lookups in imagepatch backend.
Caches validated API keys and debounces last_used_at writes on the auth path to cut CPU and DB writes.
Replaces repeated linear scans with indexed lookups and grouping in backend update enrichment.
Ambiguous: moves last_used_at writes from a detached goroutine to synchronous request-scoped writes, which is lifecycle/goroutine hygiene and states no performance improvement.
Serves cached token verification state before signature and DB validation in backend auth.
Dedupes registry lookups, runs container tag checks concurrently and batches cleanup in the image-update scan.
Defers project-list enrichment until after pagination, reducing work per list request.
Omits the large output column from the build history list query.
Dispatches notification providers concurrently with a bounded errgroup in backend notification service.
Materializes the effective settings snapshot once per refresh, replacing repeated cloning and reflection on reads.
Preloads API key permission grants in one query instead of per-key lookups (N+1 removal).
Deployment and infra config (Envoy nofile limit, Kafka partitions, docs, benchmark tooling), not a code-level performance fix.
Title 'perf(judge): batch official testcase execution' changes the judge worker's go_judge_client; body is empty so this rests on the title.
Fixes N+1 queries in EvolutionChainDetailSerializer with a single batched query.
Batches per-entry guid existence checks into one query during feed refresh.
Infinite scroll and board scrolling UX in apps/web frontend; the backend-load remark is incidental.
Ambiguous: mainly switches the plugin build toolchain to TinyGo and renames an allocator export, with a lowered body-size default; it is build/config change, not a request-path fix.
Fixes frontend pagination state reset on tab refocus in interaction-layout.tsx, which is a browser bug rather than a performance issue.

Replaces per-check DataFrame.eval with vectorised numpy in planning validation (25.5 ms to 3.3 ms per device), reducing CPU on the scheduling path; the 'found while profiling the test suite' note is incidental.
Scheduler model nonzeros grew quadratically with horizon; the recursive stock balance makes them linear and solves 10-22x faster (linear_optimization.py).
Sensor stats query timed out on >10M rows; filtering NaNs without a subquery speeds up the server-side query (data/services/sensors.py).
Defers heavy imports (pyomo, LightGBM, Sentry helpers) to cut boot/import time, not request or job handling cost; ambiguous but it targets startup, so false.
Eager-loads owner/type/child_assets on GET /api/v3_0/assets, removing N+1 queries (409 to 10 queries, about 7x faster).
Removes an N+1 lazy-load of sensors on the assets listing endpoint with selectinload (about 6-7 s to 3.1 s).
Adds missing PostgreSQL indexes in the storage backend so result and condition queries are much faster (page load 15.2 s to 900 ms).

Adds a partial index on events.tool_name in server/db.js so the analytics tool-usage query stops full-scanning (45.7 s to 0.25 s) and blocking the Node thread; the 'Infrastructure' checkbox does not change that it is a server-side query fix.

Titled perf(frontend) and mainly restructures frontend load ordering; the backend stocks.py change batches agent display names but the description frames it as a display change, so ambiguous and answered false.
